name: Quedlinburg (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided black over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Quedlinburg (a black eagle with a castle on its breast on yellow).
history: The flag of the city consists of the colours of the city in stripes with the city arms laid on; until 1998 a different rendering of the arms was used.

features.role: Quedlinburg arms — black eagle with castle on yellow
